title: Shipping Rules
seo: Shipping rates, zones and delivery options setup
meta: Shipping rates, zones and delivery options set up to match your costs and your customers. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Shipping rules that match your business
overview: Shipping that does not match your costs eats your profit, and shipping that confuses shoppers loses sales. We set up your rates in your own store: zones by country or region, flat, weight and price based rates, free shipping thresholds, local pickup and delivery options. We check each rule with test orders, so the prices at checkout match your carrier costs. You receive a sheet showing every rule and how it works.

faq: Can you use live carrier rates?
Where your plan or an app supports it. Some platforms charge more for live rates. We tell you the cost and offer a simple flat rate set if it is not worth it.
Do you set the prices for me?
We set the structure and suggest rates from your carrier costs and sales. You approve the final prices, because you know your margins best.
How are taxes and duties handled?
Taxes are set through your platform's tax settings. For international orders, we add clear messages about duties and taxes, so shoppers know what to expect at delivery.
Can I change the rules later?
Yes. The rule sheet explains each setting, so you or your team can update rates when carrier prices change. We can also adjust them in a new order.
